relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: In mice pretreated with vehicle, CGRP injection led to a significant reduction in time spent in the light chamber compared to vehicle-only controls, indicating a strong light aversion phenotype.

relationships.subject: CBD:THC
relationships.evidence_quote: mice pretreated with the 100:1 CBD:THC combination showed a complete rescue from CGRP-induced light aversion

relationships.subject: CBD:THC
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrate that the 100:1 CBD:THC combination partially rescues the squinting behavior caused by central CGRP administration

relationships.subject: CB1
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of CB1 receptors in the trigeminal ganglion has been shown to suppress CGRP release47,56

key_findings: 100:1 CBD:THC rescued i.c.v. CGRP-induced light aversion (fully in females, partially in males) and partially rescued squint
